stories.headline: China warns about AI risks with Anthropic's Claude Code
stories.body: China said specific versions of Claude Code posed back-door vulnerabilities that could send sensitive information to a remote server.

stories.headline: Nium Acquires Cypher to Bridge Fiat and Crypto
stories.body: Nium has acquired Cypher to further develop Nium as the core infrastructure layer for compliant money movement and value exchange that bridges fiat and digital assets. The acquisition brings together Nium’s cross-border payments infrastructure and Cypher’s crypto-native non-custodial wallet and issuing capabilities, Nium said in a Wednesday (July 8) press release.
